Place the VOICEVOX CORE development files in the following directory:

third_party/voicevox_core/

Required directory structure:

voicevox_core/
├─ c_api/
│  ├─ include/
│  └─ lib/
├─ dict/
│  └─ open_jtalk_dic_utf_8-1.11/
├─ models/
│  └─ vvms/
└─ onnxruntime/
   └─ lib/

Obtain VOICEVOX CORE from the official repository:

https://github.com/VOICEVOX/voicevox_core

Do not commit these files to the repository. They are ignored by `.gitignore`.
Review and comply with the licenses and usage terms for VOICEVOX CORE and its
voice models.
